senses.gloss: (denomin. of next w., v. עַרְבֵּל) to sift, shake.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 26b:8">B. Mets. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>דאייתי ארבלא ומְאַרְבֵּל</he> Ar. (Ms. R. 2 <he>מארביל</he>, ed. <he>וקא מַרְבֵּל</he> = <he>מארבל</he>) that he brought a sieve and sifted the sand.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>וקמרבלינהו</he> Ms. M. (ed. Sonc. <he>וקא מא׳ להו</he>, oth. ed. <he>מהדר להו</he>) and shook them.
<cite ref="Chullin 49a:4">Ḥull. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>מירבל הוא דרְבִיל</he> it was shaken down (by the movements of the animal). [Targ. <cite ref="P01285"><he>עַרְבֵּל</he></cite>.]
